info.name: Campus Errand - User & Supplier Service API Tests
info.description:
AI Assistance Disclosure:
Tool: Claude Code (model: Sonnet 5), date: 2026-09-28
Scope: Generated this full Postman collection (every route in user-service and supplier-service, true-positive and true-negative auth/authorization cases, request/response assertions) from a live read-only audit of both services' route handlers, shared auth middleware, and common-dtos types. Test design (folder order, what counts as a must-have case, the cookie-based logout/refresh sequencing, and the decision to leave the test user active with no delete step since no delete-user endpoint exists) is the author's, given in the approved plan; this file is the implementation of that plan.
Author review: (to be completed by author after review)

Run this collection top-to-bottom (Collection Runner, sequential — the default) against a freshly seeded local stack (`docker compose down -v && docker compose up --build`, or at least `npm run db:seed --workspace=@campus-errand/user-service`). Hits user-service and supplier-service directly on their published ports (8001/8002), bypassing the gateway entirely, since Postman isn't subject to browser CORS and both services already publish their ports directly in docker-compose.yml.

Admin/student access tokens captured in Folder 1 remain valid for the rest of the run even after their logout calls (stateless JWT, 15 min TTL by default) — only the refresh-token cookie is revoked by logout, not the access token already saved into the environment. If a run takes longer than the access-token TTL, just re-run Folder 1.

Known quirks intentionally asserted as-is (not bugs to silently work around): PATCH /api/users/:id/admin with a syntactically invalid UUID returns 500, not 400/404 (uncaught Postgres error, not a UserError); supplier-service's PUT/PATCH-toggle/DELETE resolve :id by UUID only, no supplierCode fallback (unlike GET).

AI Assistance Disclosure (addendum):
Tool: Claude Code (model: Sonnet 5), date: 2026-09-28
Scope: Added 3.18-3.22, exercising the new DELETE /api/users/:id endpoint (self-or-admin account deletion) at the end of the test user's lifecycle in Folder 3: a cross-user forbidden case (another student cannot delete someone else's account), a no-token case, an unknown-UUID case, the real self-delete cleanup (closing the one gap this collection had at launch — user-service previously had no delete endpoint at all), and an already-deleted idempotency check.
Author review: (to be completed by author after review)

AI Assistance Disclosure (addendum 2):
Tool: Claude Code (model: Sonnet 5), date: 2026-09-28
Scope: 3.11-3.15 renamed from PATCH /:id/admin to PATCH /:id/toggle-status (backend route renamed, same behavior). Replaced 3.16-3.17 (the old POST /:id/promote 501-stub requests) with 3.16-3.21, covering the newly-implemented PATCH /:id/toggle-role: forbidden for a non-admin, no token, an unknown UUID, an admin targeting their own id (blocked), and the real promote/demote round trip on the test user. The trailing DELETE requests renumbered from 3.18-3.22 to 3.22-3.26 accordingly. 1.1 Login as Admin now also captures adminUserId, needed for the self-targeting test.
Author review: (to be completed by author after review)
